A contact shorter than that along the path can fall between poses, and a smallest clearance is within that much of the smallest over the poses. Inside a run of overlapping poses one pose in up to 7 is measured and the run counts as overlapping throughout; the swept overlap is the union of up to 32 of the overlapping poses, spread evenly along them.
